content.text: Digital creators in restricted countries can't access Stripe, limiting their options for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-trap-most-creators-walk-2|selling]] digital products through platforms like Gumroad and Payhip. This exclusion affects creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines, among other countries. To overcome this infrastructure barrier, creators must consider alternative [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-how-bangladeshi-freelancers-accept-international|The Real]] that doesn't rely on Stripe or other restricted payment gateways. They must choose between five primary alternatives: Gumroad, Payhip, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/lemon-squeezy-alternatives-restricted-countries-what-nobody-tells|COREMERCH guide to lemon]] Squeezy, Paddle, and NOWPayments, but these options come with significant drawbacks. For instance, Gumroad has limited analytics, and Payhip is notorious for its high fees. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are also constrained by restricted country lists and payment processing limitations. NOWPayments, on the other hand, offers a sovereign commerce solution that decouples payment processing from Stripe, enabling creators to sell digital products without relying on a restricted payment gateway. By choosing the right infrastructure, creators can regain control over their digital commerce operations and adapt to changing market conditions.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad offers a straightforward way to sell digital products, but its limited analytics and lack of customization options make it less appealing to creators who need more control over their sales data. Payhip, on the other hand, provides more advanced features, including customizable storefronts and affiliate management, but its high fees and limited support for certain payment methods make it a less attractive option. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle offer more comprehensive e-commerce solutions, but their restricted country lists and payment processing limitations make them unsuitable for creators in many countries. NOWPayments, however, provides a sovereign commerce solution that decouples payment processing from Stripe, enabling creators to sell digital products without relying on a restricted payment gateway. With NOWPayments, creators can customize their storefronts, manage their sales data, and automate their payments without any limitations.

Gumroad and Payhip have limited international presence, making them unsuitable for creators in many countries. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle, on the other hand, have restricted country lists that exclude many countries from accessing their services. NOWPayments, however, offers a sovereign commerce solution that is not restricted by country or payment method, making it the ideal choice for creators in restricted countries. NOWPayments, on the other hand, charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it the most cost-effective option for creators. In addition, NOWPayments offers faster payment processing, ensuring that creators receive their payments quickly and efficiently.
